subject: Reschedule: technical demo pending vendor intake and travel

Subject: Request: technical demo and intake checklist

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the quick responses last week. We'd like to schedule a technical demo for the Redwood inference platform with our SRE and security leads so they can validate integration patterns. Tentative window: week of Dec 21.

Before we can book the demo, procurement requires:
- completed vendor security questionnaire (see attached)
- a signed mutual NDA or our standard vendor agreement on file
- SOC2 evidence or equivalent (a summary link is fine)

I've attached the questionnaire (Novacorp_Vendor_Questionnaire.xlsx). Can you confirm who on your side will own the intake and an ETA on the completed questionnaire and NDA? Note: our security team is partly out for travel the week of Dec 21–22, so there may be a slight delay on their review.

Appreciate it,
Maria

Procurement Lead — NovaCorp

Hi Maria — thanks for the checklist and context.

Quick answers:
- Ben (cc) will be the AE coordinating scheduling.
- Lauren (cc) will lead the security intake and complete the questionnaire with support from our infra team.
- We can return the completed questionnaire and our standard mutual NDA by EOD Dec 18. I've attached our NDA draft so you can share with legal if you'd like (Redwood_NDA_Draft_v1.pdf).

If your security reviewers are unavailable on Dec 21–22, would you prefer we push the live demo to the week of Dec 27, or hold a short pre-recorded architecture walkthrough in the interim? Options:
1) Hold live demo week of Dec 27 once intake is signed off
2) Share a 20–30min recorded walkthrough for your team to review while procurement/sec complete the review

We can flex based on your review timeline — lmk what works.

Best,
